recap.text: Donut opens the turkey-barn fight by casting her mystic card, The Thief, at an ogre mid-summon, and the ogre's card poofs out of her hand into Donut's deck. Against the hydra, she steals a protection utility and hurls it onto the forming spider, so Lucian's card against Shi Maria fizzles. Against Amayon, she steals Banjo, a level-120 Hell Scrub that drags a succubus off Carl.

beats.headline: A gift from a river goddess
beats.text: In her temple, Yemaya thanks Bomo for repairing her shrine and hands out tokens of her gratitude, one for brave Sister Ines and one for beautiful Princess Donut. Donut takes hers out of the air before Carl can examine it. It has the black border of mythical rareness, second only to the orange uniques. It is a mystic card, she shout-whispers, so they have all five kinds now; it lets them steal a card from someone else, it is not even consumable, and it is called The Thief.
beats.gist: Donut receives The Thief from Yemaya, a black-bordered mythical mystic card that steals another's card.

beats.headline: Out of the ogre's hand
beats.text: Donut opens the turkey-barn fight with Skylar Spinach and, at the same moment, casts her mystic card, The Thief, at the ogre, who is in the middle of summoning a card of her own. The card poofs out of the ogre's hand and appears in Donut's deck. Weren't expecting that, were ya, Donut calls with autotuned glee, as she tosses a Greased Lightning onto Skylar.
beats.gist: Donut casts The Thief at the ogre mid-summon, takes her card, and tosses Greased Lightning onto Skylar.

beats.headline: A protection, stolen
beats.text: As the giant Christmas cat starts to form, Donut plays her Thief card on the hydra, stealing a card from its hand, and scoffs loudly at whatever she has taken. It is a protection utility. When Shi Maria comes out, Donut hurls it onto the forming spider, and the card Lucian throws at Shi Maria disappears, ineffective, as the protection sputters out. He just wasted it, Donut crows: she used his own card against him.
beats.gist: Donut steals a protection card from the hydra, then hurls it at the forming spider, wasting Lucian's card.

beats.headline: Banjo, from a demon lord
beats.text: Donut's first move against Amayon is The Thief, cast just as the demon lord sweeps out his first totem. A card, not the one he is summoning, flicks up out of his deck, resizes itself and lands in her hand. Holy wow, she calls, look at that card. It is Banjo, a level-120 Hell Scrub, a gorilla-sized cloud of black tentacles, and it is what drags a succubus off Carl as his shield sparks out.
beats.gist: Donut casts The Thief on Amayon and takes Banjo, a level-120 Hell Scrub, from him.
